scope_notes: Only TCP was scanned (connect scan, -sT); UDP services are not covered.
Service and version names are Nmap fingerprint matches and can be inaccurate.
Only Nmap's default top 1000 TCP ports were scanned.
Host discovery was skipped (-Pn) because the target was named explicitly; a host status reason of 'user-set' means Nmap assumed the host was up.
The scan included this machine's own address. That traffic stays inside the local network stack, so results show what is listening, not what other hosts can reach through firewalls or NAT.
